## findings

1. **SOURCE-POLICY RED + SOURCE-TASK RED (charter finding F2, `_difficulty.md` § findings).** This is an undeclared override.
   - *Symptom:* reinstate_option_line_5b4fa2c4.price has two defensible values, 3453.80 (GT) and 3335.00.
   - *Root cause:* design_ext_line_reinstatement_price re-anchors the staleness of the quote ("The quote escalation percent is set by the calendar days from the date the removed line was first selected … more than the package's price protection days … mid_quote_escalation_pct percent"). It also states that the line "names the most recent selection appointment as the appointment at which it was quoted". The base design_option_selection sentence "A quoted option price is honored only when the line is added within option_price_protection_days calendar days after the appointment at which it was quoted … after that the current studio price applies" is still in force and is not named in `overwrite`, which names only "Options are added to the file at the price quoted at the appointment."
   - *Evidence:* appointment seq 2 on 2026-09-15 (initial_state.design_events.1ad1af16-03dd-4cbd-8b9c-6670e434a4ac); OPT-BC0341-005 first selected 2026-08-05 (9fd4f4ff-6d73-4e51-befd-55c3c37891b6); Studio Select option_price_protection_days 30; GT design_rationale Step 12 card.
   - *Consequence:* 3453.80 vs 3335.00.
   - *Affected:* `design.extended.yaml` design_ext_line_reinstatement_price `overwrite`, rule and compute `quote_escalation_pct`; GT final action `price`; factor quote_escalation, which is the factor whose tier the base gate contradicts.
   - *Relation to previous revisions:* first audit.
2. **Observation O-T1.** The seed posts RCPT-DS-30731 by wire on a Studio Select file, although Studio Select accepts only [card, ach, check]. The cure_rate tier (wire → 50%) rests on that row. No second scored value can be demonstrated, because the cure rule does not condition on the method being accepted. The world is inconsistent with the base `design_option_deposits` sentence "Payments must use accepted_payment_methods".
3. **Observation (O6).** The reinstated line is written under the existing CO-2 rather than a new change order. This is literally consistent with base "Every set of changes … is written as one numbered change order". No consequence.
